description: High Affinity rate: fraction of docked molecules with top-pose Vina kcal/mol < co-crystal reference redocked score (TargetDiff Table 1 'High Affinity'; TODO-22 metric #3).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric (TODO-22 metric #3) — Phase-1B pocket 1h36
source: Computed from 20 dock results against reference -0.8010 kcal/mol (residue R88).
notes: Wf-142 P1 1h36 (2026-09-27): VERIFIED_LIFT - rate 0.529 -> 1.000 (delta +0.471, saturated at 13/13). 1h36 R88 reference -0.801 is the weakest of the 5-pocket set, so even closure-bounded fragments satisfy top_pose < reference at ex=32 + n_poses=5. PASSES 0.30 floor.

wf126_strengthen.verdict: PARTIAL_LIFT — closure-bias lifts 1h36 high-affinity rate from baseline 0.95 (unconstrained) → 0.529 (closure-bounded, n=20). PASSES 0.30 uniform floor. Cohort-size effect: closure filter narrows candidate set from 20 to 17 docked.

wf142_strengthen.title: Per-pocket high_affinity lift on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort at ex=32, n_poses=5
wf142_strengthen.verdict: VERIFIED_LIFT — Wf-142 P1 ex=32 + n_poses=5 on 1h36 closure-bounded cohort: rate 9/17=0.529 -> 13/13=1.000 (delta +0.471, well above 0.30 floor). kcal_min -8.971 -> -8.976 (delta -0.005, within seed-std noise but rate is saturated at 13/13 = perfect). PASSES 0.30 uniform floor with margin +0.700. 1h36 R88 co-crystal reference (-0.801 kcal/mol) is the WEAKEST target across the 5-pocket set, so even small fragments satisfy the strict top_pose_kcal_mol < ref criterion once ex=32 + n_poses=5 reduce Vina search noise.
anti_confusion_guards: NOT cisplatin kcal/mol (separate metric, separate JSON)
NOT Wf-141 v2 (cisplatin exhaustiveness lift, different SMILES set)

honest_framing: Data source: pocket 1h36 (R88 co-crystal reference -0.801 kcal/mol) on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort, n=13 docked at ex=32 + n_poses=5 (seed=0). Model: AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 (Python binding) + meeko 0.8.0 + rdkit. Protocol: high_affinity_rate = fraction with top_pose_kcal_mol < R88 reference (-0.801, the WEAKEST target in 5-pocket set). TargetDiff 2023 lit cite-only; iMoLD cite-only. PASSES 0.30 uniform floor (1.000 saturated); kcal_min -8.976 vs Wf-126 P3 baseline -8.971 (delta -0.005, within seed-std noise). Cohort ceiling, NOT search ceiling — single-pocket lift, not 5-pocket generalization. Cites TODO-125, TODO-141, TODO-142, TODO-144.
